topics.name: Library
topics.purpose: Define grouping-only parent Topic identity TOPIC_LIBRARY already referenced by 6 existing canonical child Topic reference occurrence(s).

metadata.host_selection_rule: storage-only: direct child contract with most references; lexical canonical-id tie-break

semantics.identity_rule: Physical artifact, package, canonical module/resource and runtime instance identities remain distinct.
semantics.action_rule: Install/remove/validate/enable/start operations invoke separate authorized canonical workflows.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing artifacts grants no install/load/execute authority.
semantics.trace_rule: Every installed/error state retains source/package/dependency refs.
semantics.layout_rule: Visual order never establishes install/source precedence.
semantics.failure_rule: Missing/incompatible dependencies are shown explicitly with deterministic remediation where known.

invariants.rule: Library discovery and installation are explicit source/package lifecycle semantics; filesystem presence, discovery order or installation never silently changes canonical identity, enables dependencies or activates runtime effects.

hard_gates.condition: monitor directly installs without explicit operation
